# Copilot Avatar

![Copilot Avatar Demo](assets/copilot-avatar-squad-demo.gif)

Copilot Avatar gives GitHub Copilot CLI a lively desktop companion beside your terminal. It shows an animated Copilot head or Clippy, changes expression based on what Copilot is doing, and speaks back when the job is done.

I built it because I wanted Copilot to feel more like a colleague: it goes off to work on something, then reconnects with me when it has something useful to say.

## Why it is fun

- **Animated avatar**: render the main character as **Copilot** or **Clippy**
- **Expressive feedback**: see it react while Copilot is thinking, reading, writing, or running
- **Sub-agent cast**: delegated agents appear automatically as work fans out
- **Speaks back**: final answers can be read aloud so Copilot can call you back when it is done

## Text-to-speech

Speech is a big part of the experience. Copilot Avatar can speak using:

- **Web Speech**
- **SAM (Software Automatic Mouth) C64 version**
- **Voxtral**
- **ElevenLabs**
- **Deepgram**

## Install

You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org).

### Windows: easiest install

1. Download the latest release ZIP.
2. Extract it.
3. Run:

```powershell
.\install.ps1
```

The installer copies the extension to `%USERPROFILE%\.copilot\extensions\copilot-avatar\`, enables Copilot CLI experimental mode, turns on extension loading, preserves your avatar settings, and runs `npm install`.

If you are using this repository directly, run the same script from the repo root.

### Manual install

Copy `.github\extensions\copilot-avatar` to `%USERPROFILE%\.copilot\extensions\copilot-avatar\` and run `npm install` in that folder.

## Usage

Open the window with `/avatar`, then get back to work. Copilot Avatar keeps an eye on the session, reacts live, and speaks up again when Copilot has finished something worth hearing.

If [Squad](https://github.com/bradygaster/squad) is available, Copilot Avatar can also pick up Squad names and roles automatically.
